item.title: Pastor who gave sermon near abortion clinic stands trial
item.description: No mention of abortion was made in the sermon.

item.title: Keir Starmer praises faith and church volunteers in Christmas interview
item.description: Church volunteers "are the true Britain" and doing the country proud, the Prime Minister said.

item.title: BBC chooses Bradford Cathedral for Christmas Day broadcast
item.description: The BBC has chosen Bradford Cathedral as the location for its live Christmas Day service in 2025, coinciding with its status as UK City of Culture and placing the historic cathedral firmly in the Christmas morning spotlight.

item.title: Presbyterian Church in Ireland under investigation amid safeguarding concerns
item.description: The Charity Commission for Northern Ireland has launched an inquiry into the Presbyterian Church in Ireland.

item.title: Myanmar junta orders an early Christmas
item.description: Locals are reportedly unhappy with the decree but know that failure to comply could lead to arrest.

item.title: The Church needs to watch Channel 4's John Smyth documentary
item.description: There is much more to reflect on in these two hours, presented in a very different way from previous communications, and a year later.

item.title: Christians join Westminster protest against puberty blockers trial
item.description: The government is planning on trialling new puberty blockers for young people.

item.title: New study uncovers why some people leave their childhood faith and others stay
item.description: A new analysis from the Pew Research Center suggests that decisions about faith are often made early in life — and once made, they tend to last.

item.title: Catholics in Mozambique caring for survivors of Jihadist violence
item.description: International attention on Mozambique is scarce.

item.title: Half of Armenian archbishops have been thrown in jail
item.description: The Armenian government has been in conflict with the church for a number of years now.
